## Accommodation information

### Description

Situated in Marbella and only less than 1 km from Nueva Andalucía Beach, Villa Angelique, 5 BDR with Heated Private Pool in Puerto Banus features accommodation with mountain views, free WiFi and free private parking. This villa offers air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony. The property has a year-round outdoor pool, hot tub, solarium and garden. The spacious villa has 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, bed linen, towels, a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a terrace with sea views. Guests can take in the ambience of the surroundings from an outdoor dining area or keep themselves warm by the fireplace on colder days. For added privacy, the accommodation features a private entrance. Cycling, fishing and walking tours are possible within the area, and a water park is at guests' disposal on-site. La Cala Golf is 30 km from the villa, while Duquesa Golf Club is 40 km from the property. Malaga Airport is 62 km away.

This property will not accommodate hen, stag or similar parties. Managed by a private host
